genealogy.translator: Walter Kaufmann and R. J. Hollingdale
genealogy.title: On the Genealogy of Morals and Ecce Homo
genealogy.note: The joint translation credit applies to On the Genealogy of Morals; Ecce Homo is translated by Kaufmann.

daybreak.title: Daybreak
daybreak.note: Edited by Maudemarie Clark and Brian Leiter. Also known as The Dawn of Day in the free edition.

human-all-too-human.title: Human, All Too Human
human-all-too-human.note: Cambridge edition with an introduction by Richard Schacht. Includes both volumes; in Volume II, distinguish Assorted Opinions and Maxims from The Wanderer and His Shadow, whose section numbers restart.

human-two.title: Human, All Too Human
human-two.note: Cambridge edition with an introduction by Richard Schacht. Includes both volumes; in Volume II, distinguish Assorted Opinions and Maxims from The Wanderer and His Shadow, whose section numbers restart.

untimely-meditations.title: Untimely Meditations
untimely-meditations.note: Edited by Daniel Breazeale. Includes all four essays. The free editions divide them across two volumes under the title Thoughts Out of Season.

untimely-one.title: Untimely Meditations
untimely-one.note: Edited by Daniel Breazeale. Includes all four essays. The free editions divide them across two volumes under the title Thoughts Out of Season.

nachlass.translator: Walter Kaufmann and R. J. Hollingdale
nachlass.title: The Will to Power
nachlass.note: Edited by Kaufmann. This posthumous notebook compilation is not a finished book authorized by Nietzsche; use its numbered entries, not page numbers.

nachlass-two.translator: Walter Kaufmann and R. J. Hollingdale
nachlass-two.title: The Will to Power
nachlass-two.note: Edited by Kaufmann. This posthumous notebook compilation is not a finished book authorized by Nietzsche; use its numbered entries, not page numbers.

case-of-wagner.title: Basic Writings of Nietzsche
case-of-wagner.note: The Case of Wagner is in Basic Writings; Nietzsche Contra Wagner is in The Portable Nietzsche. These are different works.
